title: Replication Codebase: Market-Channel Orientation and Capability Constraints Shape Cross-Domain Sustainability Asymmetry in European Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
description:
Replication codebase for the empirical study "Market-Channel Orientation and Capability Constraints Shape Cross-Domain Sustainability Asymmetry in European Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises" (submitted to Business Strategy and the Environment, Wiley).

Version 2.1.0 provides the fully verified and synchronized econometric replication package: a full-information joint bivariate probit with country and sector fixed effects, RECount, and country-clustered standard errors (discrete sample-average marginal effects, joint-covariance cross-equation tests, Holm adjustment); inverse-propensity weighting (two-stage bootstrap and influence-function variance) and 1:1 propensity-score matching with fixed effects in the propensity model and a logit-scale caliper (Rosenbaum bounds); clustered robustness checks (no RECount, survey weights, routed-only, strict Q14, sector-stratified) with probability-scale moderation; and an automated 31-test econometric verification suite.

Data access: microdata come from Flash Eurobarometer 498 (ZA7806, GESIS, DOI 10.4232/1.13934) and Eurostat Digital Intensity indicators (isoc_e_dii). Raw files are public and are not redistributed; place them in Data/Raw/ as described in the README.
